title: Settlement of a Retrofit Project Balance by the Owner
content:
# Settlement of a Retrofit Project Balance by the Owner

An owner who wants to clear what stands on a project under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects settles the project balance, and the payment is recorded on that project's running account.

## What the payment does

The payment is added to the project's record entries dated the day it is made, with the way the money was sent, and the amount owed on the project falls by the amount paid. The owner sees the payment on the project statement and a lower project balance.

The amount an owner settles a project at is fixed only after the retainage held on the project stands released on its account.

Before the amount to settle is worked out, every month the project's billings have stood past their due day must be carried as a late fee on the project's billing record.

## Making the payment

Paying is the owner's own act. The tool `pay_project_balance_ec87bb4f` is a hidden tool belonging to the customer: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One call records one payment on one project.

### Parameters

- `project_id` — the reference number of the replacement or retrofit project the money is paid on, as it stands in the project lookup for this owner.
- `payment_amount_usd` — the money amount the owner is paying, in USD, given as a decimal number rounded half to even to 2 decimal places; it is stored to that same precision and may not be left empty.
- `payment_method` — how the owner is sending the money, one of: `check`, where a paper cheque is posted or handed to the office; `ach`, where the money is sent by bank transfer out of the owner's account through the automated clearing house; `credit_card`, where the owner pays on a company card; `wire`, where the owner's bank wires the money the same day.

### Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text carrying the reference of the payment record entry created on the project, the amount paid in USD to two decimal places, the way the money was sent, the day the payment was dated and the project balance after it. The owner can see the same payment line and the same balance on the project statement.
